subject: Re: MAP draft - Technical evaluation plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 20:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft - Technical evaluation plan

Thanks Jordan - great call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the MAP milestone for the technical evaluation. I've attached a draft MAP page (ACME_MAP_draft_v1.pdf) and a short benchmark guidelines spreadsheet.

Recap / Goals
- Goal: Validate model selection and serving configuration to meet latency and cost SLOs while preserving response quality for your support summarization flow.
- Target close (MAP complete): 2026-08-15 (tentative)

Proposed Technical Evaluation Milestone (summary)
- Success criteria: 1) Quality: automated metrics + human evaluation - target 85% acceptable responses on a 3-point scale; 2) Latency: 95th percentile < 150ms for 512-token generation on your pilot infra; 3) Cost: amortized inference cost < $0.40 per 1k tokens in production config (includes batching and KV cache).
- Model shortlist: Meta Llama-3 13B (q4/quantized), Mistral Large, Falcon-40B-instruct (quantized variant) - we'll provide pre-configured variants in Redwood runtime.
- Benchmarks: throughput (tokens/sec), latency P50/P95, 1k-token cost estimate, quality (BLEU/ROUGE + human pass rate), regression checks vs your baseline.
- Dependencies: sample dataset (1k representative support threads), access to a small test endpoint or dataset upload, procurement PO by 2026-07-15 for reserved test window (if dedicated capacity required).
- Responsibilities:
  - Acme: provide anonymized sample dataset + define acceptance criteria for quality; provide technical contact for infra questions.
  - Redwood (Camila / SE): run benchmark suite, tune batching/quantization, deliver runbook and results, recommend model/config.

Next steps (asks)
1) Jordan: confirm the dataset owner and timing to share (we can accept a Drive link or S3/Presigned URL).
2) Jordan / Procurement: confirm whether procurement needs a Statement of Work or PO for an extended dedicated test window.
3) Camila: will send a detailed plan with timeline, exact benchmark scripts and fields we need.

I'll follow up with the detailed technical evaluation plan tomorrow. Happy to jump on another call if you want to walk the MAP together.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: ACME_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (MAP page, 2 pages), acme-benchmark-guidelines.xlsx (spreadsheet with dataset fields and metrics)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft - Technical evaluation plan (detailed plan + benchmarks)

Hi Jordan - following up with the technical evaluation plan we discussed. Attached: acme-benchmark-guidelines.xlsx (detailed scripts + fields) and a short runbook. Summary below.

Evaluation overview- Timeline: 2-3 week pilot once we have dataset and access (baseline runs + tuning).
- Key metrics:
  - Quality: automated metrics (ROUGE, BLEU where applicable) + human evaluation (5-point acceptability scale). Pass threshold: "acceptable" >= 85% on sampled validation set.
  - Latency: P50 / P95 measured at client-observed 99-user concurrent pattern. Target: P95 < 150ms for 512-token generation on Redwood-hosted config; for Acme's initial infra we'll provide expected deltas and a configuration that targets P95 < 250ms.
  - Cost: estimated per-1k-token inference cost computed from measured throughput + reserved GPU hourly rate + amortized infra. Target: <$0.40 per 1k tokens for production config; pilot estimates will be provided per-variant.

Benchmark steps
1) Baseline: run your samples against current baseline model (if any) to capture baseline quality and latency.
2) Candidate runs: Llama-3 13B (q4_0), Mistral Large (quantized), Falcon-40B-instruct (int8) - we'll provide tuned checkpoints.
3) Tuning: measure batching, KV cache benefits, and quantization tradeoffs.
4) Human eval: set of 200 representative prompts for human rating (we recommend your support SMEs participate).
5) Regression checks: ensure no quality regressions on high-priority prompts.

Deliverables- Raw benchmark logs + summary dashboard- Runbook with recommended model variant & runtime config for production- Cost estimate per 1k tokens and recommended autoscaling policy

Responsibilities & timing- Acme (Jordan): provide dataset + confirm infra access by 2026-07-06; review and nominate 3 SMEs for human eval by 2026-07-08.
- Redwood (Camila): run baseline + candidate runs starting 2026-07-07, initial report by 2026-07-16.

Attachments referenced: acme-benchmark-guidelines.xlsx (contains exact script commands, metrics collection and Drive upload instructions).

If we get the dataset this week we can start the baseline early next week. Happy to hop on a quick 30min call to walk through the runbook.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
